messages:
release-ops: Quick PSA — we need to enact a brief release freeze starting 22:00 UTC tonight for an emergency CUDA driver hotpatch that surfaced in canary. Affected: us-west-2 canaries and a subset of Dedicated GPU pools. ETA ~3h. Follow the steps below.

release-ops: TL;DR: pause new canaries, hold scheduled rollouts, apply hotpatch to infra nodes, validate latency and KV cache integrity, then resume canaries with a fast-rollout.

release-ops: Playbook (condensed):
```
1) set release.train.mode=paused for canary lane
2) cordon affected nodes: kubectl cordon gpu-nodes-usw2-*-pool
3) apply driver hotpatch: ansible -i usw2 hosts -m shell -a 'install-driver-47.2'
4) restart runtime pods with zero-downtime order
5) run smoke tests: infra/smoke/canary-check.sh
6) if regressions, trigger rollback with: /rollout cancel --reason "driver-regression"
```

deploy-bot: @release-ops I’ve set canary lane to paused for all active trains starting at 22:00 UTC. Will post progress updates here. :white_check_mark:

oncall-eric: Copy. I’ll be on standby at 21:45 UTC to watch the patch. Please DM pager for any urgent alerts.

maya: Thanks — quick Q: will this impact Dedicated SLA? Do we need to notify impacted customers?

karen: Short answer: minimal. We’re targeting a small fraction of Dedicated; ops has a rollback budget and we’ll route traffic to unaffected regions if needed. Recommend a soft customer notice if any scheduled maintenance overlaps their reserved windows.

sahil: I’ll prepare a short blurb for support so CS doesn’t get surprised.

release-ops: Good call @maya @karen @sahil. Action items:
- @sahil: publish CS blurb (15m)
- @oncall-eric: run pre-patch health checks at 21:50 UTC
- @k8s-bot: create a CR to cordon nodes and annotate with patch-id=usw2-3745

k8s-bot: Created patch annotation CR: patch/usw2-3745 annotated on 6 nodes.

deploy-bot: Starting driver hotpatch rollout to annotated nodes at 22:05 UTC. Will update every 15m or on errors.

oncall-eric: Pre-patch checks green. Latency p50/p95 within baseline. KV cache hit-rate stable.

release-ops: If smoke tests fail, threshold for rollback is: >3% error spike sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase >150ms for 5m. We’ll escalate to infra-leads and pause all resumes.

maya: FYI I updated the release calendar and set a brief freeze tag on trains scheduled tonight.

karen: Thanks. I’ll prep a short note for the weekly release digest so we capture this in the changelog.

sahil: CS blurb posted: "We’re performing an infrastructure patch in us-west-2 tonight; minor, brief impact possible for canary and reserved GPU customers. No action required unless you see service disruption." Link: https://intranet/docs/ops/patch-usw2-3745

deploy-bot: Patch complete on 6/6 nodes. Restarting runtime pods in rolling fashion.

k8s-bot: Pods restarted; healthchecks passed for all nodes.

release-ops: Running post-patch smoke for 10m. If green we’ll lift freeze and resume canaries at 01:10 UTC.

oncall-eric: Post-patch window looks clean. No regressions seen after 12m.

release-ops: Freeze lifted. Resuming canaries with fast-rollout policy. Monitor channels for anomalies. :rocket:

maya: Great work, team. I’ll add a short note to next week’s release train: "Emergency driver hotpatch in us-west-2 — ~3h freeze, no customer impact beyond brief canary hold."

karen: Adding to changelog now. Closing this thread once deploy-bot confirms stable metrics for 1h.

deploy-bot: Monitoring metrics — stable for 20m so far. Will ping again at +60m.

oncall-eric: Standing down but will stay watchful for the next hour.

release-ops: Thanks all. :bow:
